Additionally, sensitive data of the Company could be leaked, disclosed, or revealed as a result of or in connection with our employee’s, personnel’s, or vendor’s use of generative artificial intelligence, or AI, technologies.

Our employees and personnel may use generative AI technologies to perform their work, and the disclosure and use of personal information in generative AI technologies is subject to various privacy laws and other privacy obligations.
Governments have passed and are likely to pass additional laws regulating generative AI.
If we are unable to use generative AI, it could make our business less efficient and result in competitive disadvantages.
We use AI and machine learning, or ML, to assist us in making certain decisions, which is regulated by certain privacy laws.
